notes: GujRERA publishes no revocation list, so blocked is always empty at night and revoked is null. At the form a project whose getproject-details carries a projectRevokeDocId reads as REVOKED; no real revoked project was found to confirm that field. The register is the whole all-time list of projects under their current numbers, so absence blocks; it is not a lapse list. Numbers compare by their serial (MAA99001), so atForm searches by serial and matches on keyOf(). Fixture names: global-search_<serial>.json, alldatabyprojectid_<id>.json, getproject-details_<id>.json, projectlist_all.json. Live requests need legacy TLS renegotiation (see rera-gj.ts); the fixtures are unaffected.
